note: Bridger-Teton NF campground between the Greys River Road (FS-10138) and the Greys River, near Murphy Creek, about 14 miles up the road from Alpine; turn onto FS-10092. Sites in conifers along a spur above the river. --Claude
summary: FS page read: 10 sites, trailers to 30 ft + one 70-ft pull-through, no hookups, vault toilet, FCFS, 14-day limit, open May 1 - Sept 30 (free after), fee $7 / $18 both listed; no rec.gov listing. Riverview holds (continuous conifer band). Phone empty -> 307-886-5300. Pin fine.
flags: WATERFRONT (checked hard): riverview holds. Units on the campground spur (~43.0726,-110.8368) are ~35-40 m from the Greys River through a continuous band of conifers; no site reaches the bank over open ground. No site numbers published.
WATER CONFLICT: description 'Water is available', amenity block 'Potable water is not available at this site.' Stored potable_water true (derived) left alone.
FEE: page lists both '$7 per night' and '$18/Night for single unit' (2024 proposal $7 -> $20; outcome not found). Range 7-18 kept as on the page.
PHONE: empty -> 307-886-5300 (Greys River Ranger District, Afton; FS page). Website confirmed.
PIN: stored 43.07109,-110.83583 is at the south end of the campground spur, ~130 m from the middle of the sites (~43.0722,-110.8364) - no move.
